name: FileInsightsModule
description: Checks whether file-hash entities appear as email attachments and returns FileProfile() enrichment from Advanced Hunting.

logAnalytics: Log Analytics Reader on the Microsoft 365 Defender-linked workspace

notes: Hash values are validated against strict hex-length patterns (MD5/SHA1/SHA256) before being bound into KQL - arbitrary strings are rejected outright, not sanitized-and-passed-through.
